content.title: Oscar nominations 2026: Full list of nominees
content.text: CultureThe 2026 Oscars will air Sunday, March 15, at 7 p.m. ET on ABC.The 2026 Oscars are just days away, which means this year's nominees are in the final countdown to their night on Hollywood's biggest stage.The nominees in all 24 categories for the 98th Academy Awards were announced live in Los Angeles in January by Oscar-nominated actress Danielle Brooks and actor Lewis Pullman.Each category has five nominees, except for best picture, which has 10.An Oscar statue is pictured at the red carpet of the 96th Annual Academy Awards at the Dolby Theatre in Hollywood, California on March 9, 2024. The 96th Annual Academy Awards will be held on March 10.Pedro Ugarte/AFP via Getty ImagesThis year's Oscars ceremony will be hosted by Conan O'Brien for the second year in a row. The 98th Oscars will be held on Sunday, March 15, at the Dolby Theatre in Los Angeles.The awards will be televised live on ABC and streamed live on Hulu beginning at 7 p.m., ET.Read below for all of the 2026 nominees.Best picture"Bugonia""F1""Frankenstein""Hamnet""Marty Supreme""One Battle After Another""The Secret Agent""Sentimental Value""Sinners""Train Dreams"Best supporting actressElle Fanning, "Sentimental Value"Inga Ibsdotter Lilleaas, "Sentimental Value"Amy Madigan, "Weapons"Wunmi Mosaku, "Sinners"Teyana Taylor, "One Battle After Another"Best actorTimothée Chalamet, "Marty Supreme"Leonardo DiCaprio, "One Battle After Another"Ethan Hawke, "Blue Moon"Michael B.
